program_narrative: Program PORTTRAN is a batch program intended to process portfolio transactions. It reads the sequential TRANSACTION-FILE (record layout TRNREC) and opens the indexed PORTFOLIO-FILE (record layout from the unresolved copybook PORTREC) for update. The main loop reads one transaction at a time until end of file or until more than 100 errors have been counted. Each transaction is validated: the portfolio ID must be present and exist in PORTFOLIO-FILE, the type must be buy (BU), sell (SL), transfer (TR) or fee (FE), the quantity must be positive, and price and amount must be positive except for transfers; valid transactions are only counted, invalid ones are reported through the common error routine ERRPROC. The program contains logic to apply buys, sells and fees to portfolio units and cost and to send an audit record to AUDPROC, but the paragraph that starts it (2200-UPDATE-POSITIONS) is never performed, so no portfolio update or audit write happens on any executable path. At the end it closes both files and displays the read, processed and error counts. Error conditions handled: file open failures, missing or unknown portfolio, invalid type, non-positive quantity, price or amount.

paragraphs.pseudocode_text:

IF transaction_file_status = '00' THEN  -- transaction file opened successfully
  WHILE NOT (end_of_file OR error_count > 100) DO  -- PERFORM ... UNTIL, condition tested before each iteration
